headline: India 3-part truce plan reported as 'broadest' of four proposals
dek: India proposed a three-part truce: (1) halt attacks on energy facilities and other infrastructure, (2) keep grain/energy flowing through Black Sea ports, (3) end strikes on commercial ships. Per the Geopolitical Monitor report, FM Sybiha called it the broadest of four proposals (Turkey, Egypt, US…
sources: Geopolitical Monitor report by Nikola Mikovic, picked up by IANS; quotes Ukrainian FM Andrii Sybiha and Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov
fault_line: Real mediator or narrative? — India claims the broadest truce formula and its media ecosystem cheers, but Moscow says conditions for talks 'aren't in place' and some pro-India reels are already falsely claiming a ceasefi
